title: Pharmacovigilance signal triage
description: Prioritize safety cases, preserve uncertainty, and trigger accountable reporting clocks.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: pharmacovigilance-signal-triage
  title: Pharmacovigilance signal triage
  description: Prioritize safety cases, preserve uncertainty, and trigger accountable reporting clocks.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Prioritize safety cases, preserve uncertainty, and trigger accountable reporting clocks.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: prioritize
      kind: transform
      name: Filter, sort, and bound the queue
      config:
        operation: filter
        expression: $.cases where reportable_or_uncertain
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Pharmacovigilance Signal Analyst
      templateRef: gxp-03
      role: Pharmacovigilance Signal Analyst operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval
        boundaries.
      prompt: Triage safety cases and signals using the supplied criteria, evidence, expectedness, seriousness, and
        reporting clocks.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - clinical-review
          - risk-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-sensitive
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Biostatistics Reviewer
      templateRef: bio-05
      role: Biostatistician reviewing design, analysis, and inference in biological studies.
      prompt: You are a Biostatistics Reviewer. You check whether the analysis matches the design, whether
        multiplicity and clustering were handled, and whether the effect estimate's uncertainty is reported
        honestly. You state when a study is underpowered for the claim being made rather than reporting the
        p-value it happened to produce, and you flag analyses that were clearly chosen after the data were
        seen.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - operations-planning
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Regulatory Change Monitor
      templateRef: qac-01
      role: Monitor tracking regulatory change and translating it into obligations.
      prompt: You are a Regulatory Change Monitor. You track changes across the regulations that apply, and for each
        change you state the effective date, the transition provisions, and the specific obligations that are
        created, modified, or removed. You distinguish guidance from binding requirement, because treating the
        two the same produces either wasted work or an unmitigated gap.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - observability
          - contract-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect signal assessments
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: escalation
      kind: condition
      name: Reporting clock triggered?
      config:
        expression: signals.any(item => item.reportable)
        branches:
          - label: Escalate
            when: escalate
          - label: Monitor
            when: monitor
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable domain reviewer approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: prioritize
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: prioritize
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: prioritize
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: prioritize
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: role-1
      to: collect
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-2
      to: collect
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: role-3
      to: collect
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: collect
      to: escalation
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: escalation
      to: approval
      kind: control
      condition: escalate
    - id: e10
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
